tasks.title: Console forms use the contract patch's address and SMTP client-name rules
tasks.spec: ## Repository: console, R7, all Tests and Completion evidence; Rollout steps 1-2; Security impact; Acceptance evidence 5. After contract merges, use the same full main patch merge SHA as api (2.5.1 or next free patch) and regenerate bun.lock. Add the three parseChannelForm defect tests first and record assertion failures on c5ce6685ce8b563a243823bca451032291b81adb; the existing pulse.example.com / Pulse <pulse@example.com> valid input is a control and passes on both pins. All new cases pass after the bump. Preserve the existing errors mapping and console production code. Final checks include check, browser, deploy-dev Compose CI and the manual changed-form check, using the tool facts cited in this section.

acceptance.expected: After the bump, 0 fail: smtp_client_name pulse_console yields isOk false with channel.smtp.clientName: must be a host name; from Ops <ops@example.test> trailing yields isOk false; from Ops < ops@example.test > yields isOk true. Each of these three defect assertions fails on the old 2.4.0 pin; the existing pulse.example.com / Pulse <pulse@example.com> control passes on both. A focused run's global coverage exit status is not its test result.
exit 0; the manifest and committed lockfile agree.
exit 0; lint, typecheck (including e2e) and full tests pass; the existing 80% line coverage gate passes.

The manifest and lockfile workspace dependency contain the same full 40-character patch merge SHA, independently obtained from the merged contract child PR on main (R1-R6, version 2.5.1 or the next free patch literal named there); the lockfile resolution matches that commit.
With CONTRACT_PATCH_SHA set to the full merge SHA from the contract child PR, status is ahead or identical: the pinned patch commit is on contract main.

acceptance.command: bunx playwright install chromium && bun run check:browser
acceptance.expected: exit 0; the existing browser checks pass with Chromium (package.json:19; AGENTS.md:24; ci.yml:291,306,308).
Before committing, only package.json, bun.lock and src/notification-form.test.ts are changed or untracked.

exit 0; console check, browser and deploy-dev pass on the PR. deploy-dev starts pulse-deploy main's dev stack with this console checkout and runs E2E_CONSOLE_FLOW=two-factor bash e2e/console-setup.sh dev/compose.yaml (ci.yml:231,279). A failure where console follows the spec is a deploy defect: hold; never edit deploy or weaken the check.

The fixture console starts per AGENTS.md:25; manually attempt one email channel save with clientName pulse_console and observe channel.smtp.clientName: must be a host name. Record the command and shown error in the PR, then stop the fixture server.

Records all three old-pin assertion failures and new-pin results, the unchanged valid control passing on both pins, the independently verified main patch merge SHA/lockfile, full check/browser/Compose CI results and manual changed-form command/error. Includes the applicable Security impact dependency-pin/input-validation review.
